Scenario Description: Grid opens with columns, a blank row and actions
Test Steps: 1. Inspect the medication grid
Expected Result: Columns Generic/Brand, Dosage, Frequency, Route, Duration; one blank row with route PO; Clear All, Use Preset, Add Medication; Active Medications panel.

Scenario Description: Every real cabinet drug is found by generic name and fills the row
Test Steps: For each drug: 1. Type the first 4 letters; 2. Pick it
Expected Result: Row = cabinet generic, dosage, frequency, route exactly.

Scenario Description: Every branded drug is suggested by brand name
Test Steps: For each branded drug: type the brand
Expected Result: Suggestion shows brand, generic and Dosage: ….

Scenario Description: Every drug of the new drug database is prescribable with its own values
Test Steps: For each of 23 drugs: 1. Clear All; 2. Search full name, pick
Test Data: Includes combinations, special characters, inhaled/IM routes, missing frequency
Expected Result: Row = that drug's dosage, frequency (blank if none), route.

Scenario Description: Search is case-insensitive and partial
Test Steps: 1. Search AMOX, amox, and a middle fragment
Expected Result: The drug is suggested for every term.

Scenario Description: Unknown drug stays as free text
Test Steps: 1. Type Zzqxmycin
Expected Result: No suggestion; row keeps Zzqxmycin with route PO; saved as typed.

Scenario Description: Brand-search pick saves generic and brand correctly
Test Steps: 1. Search the brand; 2. Pick the drug
Expected Result: Saved generic_name = generic, brand_name = brand. Known defect DEF-RX-004 (test.fail()).

Scenario Description: Add Medication and Enter add rows
Test Steps: 1. Add Medication; 2. Enter in last Duration
Expected Result: 2 rows, then 3; the new row is blank with PO.

Scenario Description: Move up reorders; save keeps order
Test Steps: 1. Move row 2 up
Expected Result: Grid order swapped; saved treatments in the new order.

Scenario Description: Remove deletes only that row
Test Steps: 1. Remove row 1
Expected Result: Only the second drug remains on screen and in the save.

Scenario Description: Clear All resets the grid
Test Steps: 1. Clear All
Expected Result: One blank row; the save contains no named treatment. No confirmation is asked (OBS-RX-002).

Scenario Description: Phone-size row menu
Test Steps: 1. Open the row "⋮" menu; 2. Add Row
Expected Result: Menu items Remove and Add Row; Add Row adds a second row.

Scenario Description: Replacing a drug does not keep the old frequency
Test Steps: 1. Pick Amlodipine (OD); 2. Pick Prednisolone into the same row
Expected Result: Frequency blank on screen and in the save. Known defect DEF-RX-005 (test.fail()).

Scenario Description: Preset list shows details and can be searched
Test Steps: 1. Use Preset; 2. Search a non-existent name
Expected Result: Dialog "Add Medication Preset — Select a medication preset to add to this prescription"; preset name, notes and first medication shown; the search hides it.

Scenario Description: Choosing a preset appends its medications
Test Steps: 1. Use Preset; 2. Pick the preset
Expected Result: Original drug stays first; preset medications follow with stored dosage, frequency, route and duration; saved.

Scenario Description: Autosave sends every field
Test Steps: 1. Pick a drug; 2. Duration 5 days
Expected Result: Saved treatment = generic, brand, dosage, frequency, method, duration: "5 days", expiration_date = today + 5 days, patient_id, is_active: false; "All changes saved".

Scenario Description: Repeated save failures are reported
Test Steps: 1. Pick a drug
Expected Result: "Changes couldn't be saved after multiple attempts. Please check your network connection."

Scenario Description: Draft medications restored on reopen
Test Steps: 1. Open the patient
Test Data: Amoxicillin 500 mg TDS Oral 5 days; Paracetamol 650 mg PRN Q6H Oral 3 days
Expected Result: Both rows restored, in order, with every field.

Scenario Description: Allergy warning when prescribing an allergen
Preconditions: Patient has Penicillin allergy; Amoxicillin added as allergy
Test Steps: 1. Prescribe Amoxicillin
Expected Result: Allergy warning shown. Known defect DEF-RX-001 (test.fail()).

Scenario Description: Duplicate drug warning
Test Steps: 1. Prescribe the same drug in two rows
Expected Result: Duplicate warning shown. Known defect DEF-RX-002 (test.fail()).

Scenario Description: Impossible values rejected
Test Steps: 1. Dosage -5 mg, frequency 9999 times, duration abc
Expected Result: Values flagged and not saved. Known defect DEF-RX-003 (test.fail()).
